items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: I knew about him but I really didn’t know him that well.

ctx.x: “Face.” He called everybody face. And I found out why they did that, because you never had to remember anybody’s name. Hey Face, the Gates, and like Pops. So you didn’t know whether they really knew each other or not. “how you doing, Face?” You know. But I said oh man, I knew about him but I really didn’t know him that well. So I was going to go up there, I’m going to kill this old guy, right? Because they had drum battles. That was a drum room. The Metropole. That was a drum house. Because you know there are…
